title: My lessons
subtitle: Turn a chapter into a lesson you can listen to, read and practise.
entryTitle: Turn a chapter into a lesson
entryBody: Upload a textbook chapter (PDF). Get a short lesson, audio, a quiz and flashcards.
uploadTitle: Make a lesson from a chapter
uploadBody: Upload a textbook chapter as a PDF. We make a short lesson in simple words.
pickHint: Up to 10 MB. Photos of pages are coming soon.
tooBig: This file is bigger than 10 MB. Try a single chapter.
scan: This PDF is a scan (a photo of pages). Reading scans is coming next. Please try a PDF with selectable text.
stageHint: This takes about a minute. You can leave this page; the lesson will be saved.
tryAgain: Something went wrong. Please try again.
failed: We could not make this lesson. Please try again.
loadError: Lessons could not load. Check your network.
mineEmpty: No lessons yet. Upload a chapter above.
sharedHint: Lessons teachers and students have shared.
noAudio: Audio is not ready for this lesson. You can still read it.
someAudioMissing: Audio could not be made for some parts.
scoreGood: Well done! You understood this chapter.
scoreTryAgain: Listen to the lesson again and try once more.
shareOn: Other students can find this lesson.
shareOff: Only you can see this lesson.
deleteConfirm: Delete this lesson? This cannot be undone.
grounded: This lesson is made only from your chapter. Check with your textbook if something looks wrong.
